js: await __sleep(6500);const wm=()=>{const car=window.__car;car.updateMatrixWorld(true);const v=new (car.position.constructor)();let ys=[],cx=[],cz=[];for(const n of ['WheelFrontL','WheelFrontR','WheelRearL','WheelRearR']){const w=car.getObjectByName(n);let y=1e9,x0=1e9,x1=-1e9,z0=1e9,z1=-1e9;w.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh){const p=o.geometry.getAttribute('position');for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++){v.fromBufferAttribute(p,i).applyMatrix4(o.matrixWorld);y=Math.min(y,v.y);x0=Math.min(x0,v.x);x1=Math.max(x1,v.x);z0=Math.min(z0,v.z);z1=Math.max(z1,v.z)}}});ys.push(y);cx.push((x0+x1)/2);cz.push((z0+z1)/2)}const m=a=>a.reduce((s,n)=>s+n,0)/a.length;return {minY:+Math.min(...ys).toFixed(4),maxY:+Math.max(...ys).toFixed(4),cx:+m(cx).toFixed(4),cz:+m(cz).toFixed(4)}};const log=[['closed',wm()]];const V=__vehicle.getState();V.toggleDoor('frontLeft');V.toggleDoor('frontRight');V.toggleFrunk();V.toggleTrunk();await __sleep(1800);log.push(['doors+hood+hatch open',wm()]);V.toggleDoor('frontLeft');V.toggleDoor('frontRight');V.toggleFrunk();V.toggleTrunk();await __sleep(1800);log.push(['closed again',wm()]);const bf=wm();return JSON.stringify(log)
